_provenance.note: 手写整理的接口事实（从上游 Apache-2.0 源码的 Rust struct / #[tool] 宏描述转写为 JSON Schema 风格），非反编译产物。基线：block/goose v1.53.0, commit 5bd5e548（2026-10-05）。本机无安装，故无实测成分；每条目 source 字段标注上游文件:行号。

platforms.note: computer_control 仅注册于 target_os = macos（tool_router_macos 条件编译）

execution_backend.auto_install: 首次调用时 which peekaboo 检测，缺失则 brew install steipete/tap/peekaboo，并把 $(brew --prefix)/bin 修入子进程 PATH
execution_backend.os_requirements: macOS 15+；TCC：Screen Recording + Accessibility（由 peekaboo 二进制触发，goose 不管理）

tools.name: computer_control
tools.description: macOS UI automation via Peekaboo CLI. Pass a subcommand string as `command`. Core workflow: see → click → type. Key commands: see, image, click, type, press, hotkey, paste, scroll, drag, swipe, move, app, window, list, menu, menubar, dock, dialog, clipboard, space, open, permissions.

command.description: The peekaboo subcommand and arguments as a single string. Examples: "see --app Safari --annotate"; "click --on B1"; "type \"hello\" --return"; "hotkey --keys cmd,c"; "app launch Safari --open https://example.com"; "window list --app Safari --json"; "press tab --count 3"; "clipboard --action get"

capture_screenshot.description: Whether to capture and return a screenshot as part of the result. Useful after click/type actions to see the updated UI state.

content_blocks.notes: peekaboo stdout；超过 12000 字符截断并附 [Output truncated. N total chars.]；带 annotations.audience=[assistant]
base64 编码。see/image 命令返回本次截图（存在 *_annotated.png 时返回标注版）；capture_screenshot=true 时动作后补拍 image --mode frontmost

behavior.timeout: 工具级 timeout 300s（builtin extensions 默认）；peekaboo 子进程本身无超时
behavior.no_session_semantics: 无 lease/generation/后台交付/急停；--snapshot 复用与焦点控制（--no-auto-focus 等）由 peekaboo 自身参数提供

tools.name: xlsx_tool
tools.description: Process Excel (XLSX) files: list_worksheets / get_columns / get_range / find_text / update_cell / get_cell / save.

tools.name: docx_tool
tools.description: Word (DOCX) extract_text / update_doc（mode: append|replace|structured|add_image，支持 bold/italic/underline/size/color/alignment 样式）.

tools.name: pdf_tool
tools.description: PDF extract_text / extract_images（图片存为 PNG）.

browser.note: Goose 内核与桌面端均无内置浏览器控制工具（crates/ 全树无 CDP/WebDriver 实现；desktop webview 导航不暴露给 agent）。浏览器能力 = 外部 MCP 扩展，工具 schema 归各上游，此处仅列官方收录条目的安装面。

official_catalog_extensions.name: Playwright
official_catalog_extensions.capability: 跨 Chromium/WebKit 自动化与 web 测试（官方主推）

official_catalog_extensions.name: Chrome DevTools
official_catalog_extensions.capability: Chrome 自动化、性能测试、web 调试

official_catalog_extensions.name: Selenium MCP
official_catalog_extensions.capability: 网页导航与表单自动化（WebDriver）

official_catalog_extensions.name: Puppeteer
official_catalog_extensions.capability: 无头浏览器自动化（server 已 archived，文档 unlisted）

official_catalog_extensions.name: Browserbase
official_catalog_extensions.capability: 云端浏览器：导航、交互、抓取

install_mechanics.config_shape: config.yaml extensions.<key>: {enabled, type: stdio, cmd, args, envs, env_keys, timeout, cwd, bundled}（或 type: streamable_http {uri}；SSE 已禁用）
install_mechanics.enterprise_allowlist: GOOSE_ALLOWLIST env → YAML URL，extensions: [{id, command}]，按安装命令白名单放行

browser.cu_fallback: computer_control 'open <url> --app <浏览器>' / 'app launch <浏览器> --open <url>' + see --annotate + click 即可用屏幕控制驱动浏览器（官方教程示例形态）

labels.smart_approve: Ask only for sensitive tool calls

permission_level.storage: ~/.config/goose/permission.yaml（按扩展名分组三张名单；类别含 user 与 smart_approve）

llm_review_layers.name: smart_approve
llm_review_layers.mechanism: 内部 LLM 工具 platform__tool_by_tool_permission 判定请求是否严格只读；只读放行；请求 ID/参数视为不可信；无法判定即非只读

llm_review_layers.name: adversary_mode
llm_review_layers.mechanism: ~/.config/goose/adversary.md 规则文件存在即启用；独立 agent 对每个工具调用 ALLOW/BLOCK 复核；fail-open

permission_model.cu_specific: 无 CU 专用分级（无应用 tier/按应用授权/急停）；TCC 两权限（Screen Recording + Accessibility）由 peekaboo 触发并归操作系统管理
